description: Orbit of an object: perigee and apogee altitudes (periapsis/apoapsis), period, inclination, eccentricity, semi-major axis. Earth satellites: the mean elements of their published element set, with the orbit regime (LEO, MEO, GEO, HEO); other objects: instantaneous two-body elements around their centre at a date (default: the body they orbit; inclination on its equator, on the ecliptic around the Sun).

centre.description: Body the orbit is around, e.g. "sun" for a planet or a probe.

id.description: Object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "25544" for the ISS.

name: perigee_orbit
title: Orbit
